keyFindings.description: common.sh:120-122: when flock fails and neither the record's pid nor any fd-9 holder is visible in this PID namespace (a run of another Legion role on a shared root, e.g. the default /legion/scratch/tmp/dispatch-loadtest), the refusal says 'no process holds it now ... has exited. Try again', though the failed flock proves a holder exists; an operator who believes it may delete .run.lock, which lets the next run in. README.md:180-184 claims the refusal always names the live holder. Fix: retry flock once in that branch (take the lock if it succeeds), otherwise say the holder is not visible from this PID namespace and not to remove the lock file.
